jobs.description_text:
About the role

We are seeking an experienced Machine Learning Lead to helm our Machine Learning team.

In this pivotal role, you will be the engineering architect behind Vulcan’s core AI capabilities. You will act as the nexus between Research, Platform, and Product. Your mission is to translate cutting-edge findings on GenAI threats into robust, production-ready machine learning models that power our GenAI Security Guardrails (Blue Team) and Automated Vulnerability Assessment (Red Team).

Crucially, you will serve as the bridge between deep tech and business strategy, articulating technical constraints (like FLOPS and latency) to leadership and clients while guiding the engineering direction.

Key Responsibilities

1. Model Development & Optimization (Training & Fine-tuning):

  • Research to Production: Collaborate with the Security Research Team to operationalize new threat detection techniques. They identify the "what" (e.g., new prompt injection patterns); you determine the "how" (model architecture, training strategy).
  • Fine-tuning & Adaptation: Lead the fine-tuning of Language Models (e.g., using LoRA/PEFT) to optimize for our supported muti-lingual languages and specific security intents.
  • Multimodal Readiness: Prepare the system for Multimodal (Text + Image/Audio) capabilities. Evaluate and implement models to detect visual prompt injections and non-textual threats as the product evolves.

2. MLOps& Data Infrastructure:

  • Enhance & Scale MLOps: Take ownership of our existing ML pipelines. Focus on optimizing and scaling CI/CD/CT workflows to improve training efficiency and deployment velocity.
  • Data Governance: Implement and enforce rigorous Data Versioning strategies (e.g., DVC) to ensure complete reproducibility of model artifacts and datasets.
  • Monitoring & Reliability: Maintain rigorous monitoring for model drift and performance, ensuring high reliability in a production security environment.

3. Cross-Functional Implementation & Leadership:

  • Platform Collaboration: Work closely with the Platform Engineering Team to integrate ML models into the broader product architecture. Ensure seamless interaction between model inference services and the main platform logic.
  • Team Leadership: Lead and mentor Machine Learning Engineers, fostering a culture of engineering rigor, code quality, and operational excellence.
  • Resource Management: Manage GPU resources and compute budgets effectively for both training and inference workloads.

4. Technical Strategy & Stakeholder Management:

  • Translating Tech to Business: Act as the technical voice of the ML team. You must effectively explain complex ML concepts (e.g., FLOPS, quantization trade-offs, model latency vs. accuracy) to executive leadership and clients.
  • Cost-Benefit Analysis: Justify compute resource investments. Articulate the trade-off between infrastructure costs (GPU hours) and performance gains to non-technical stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years in Machine Learning Engineering, with specific experience in leading technical projects or mentoring engineers.
  • Communication & Business Acumen: Exceptional ability to distill complex technical topics (e.g., compute complexity, infrastructure costs) into clear, business-relevant insights for decision-makers.
  • MLOps Proficiency: Proven experience in optimizing ML pipelines and infrastructure. Familiarity with tools like MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, and Data Versioning tools (DVC, etc.).
  • Engineering First: Proficient in Python, Docker, and Kubernetes. You treat ML models as software artifacts that need testing and version control.
  • NLP & LLM Expertise: Experience with Transformer architectures, Embeddings, and LLM fine-tuning. Familiarity with frameworks like PyTorch, Hugging Face, and vLLM.
  • Language Support: Experience processing or fine-tuning models for multi-lingual environments.

Nice to Have

  • Multimodal Expertise: Experience working with Multimodal models (Image-to-Text, Text-to-Image, VLMs like CLIP, LLaVA).
  • Security Awareness: Understanding of GenAI security threats (e.g., Prompt Injection).
  • High-Performance Computing: Experience optimizing inference speed (quantization, distillation, vLLM) for real-time applications.

jobs.description_text: ABOUT AIRWALLEX Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full. HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT You’ll lead the technical design, execution, and people leadership for Kai, Airwallex’s AI assistant for complex financial work. You’ll turn rapidly evolving LLM and agent capabilities into reliable, observable, and safe production systems that understand intent, retrieve business context, reason over products and data, and take appropriate actions. You’ll set the technical direction for agent orchestration, context and retrieval, tool integrations, identity and access control, observability, evaluation, and responsible action-taking, while balancing quality, latency, reliability, cost, security, and time to market. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Data, Security, Infrastructure, and domain teams to deliver trusted AI products and reusable platforms that can scale across Airwallex. You’ll manage, coach, and develop AI, backend, and frontend engineers, set clear expectations, and raise the engineering bar through hiring, feedback, and technical mentorship. You'll work from our Singapore office five days a week. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ESSENTIALS - You have 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years leading, managing, or formally mentoring engineers. - You have a track record of building strong teams and delivering complex products end to end. - You have deep experience designing and operating scalable agentic architecture, backend systems, or distributed systems. - You understand the engineering realities of retrieval, model integration, agent workflows, evaluation, observability, and changing model behaviour. - You bring a disciplined approach to evaluation, monitoring, incident management, performance, testing, and operational readiness. - You understand secure software design, including authentication, authorisation, data protection, auditability, and abuse prevention. - You can define and evolve technical architecture across agent orchestration, context and retrieval, tool integrations, identity and access control, observability, and evaluation systems. - You can lead the delivery of production-grade AI features from discovery through launch and iteration. - You can establish product and model success metrics, instrument customer journeys, and use real-world feedback to improve AI usefulness and trustworthiness. - You can build repeatable, versioned evaluation practices for task success, groundedness, tool use, safety, and domain-specific failure modes. - You can define launch criteria, staged-rollout and rollback mechanisms, and monitoring that detects regressions as models, prompts, and data evolve. - You can drive engineering excellence across service design, APIs, data pipelines, reliability, performance, cost efficiency, testing, incident response, and operational readiness. - You can define and improve SLOs for critical AI services. - You can champion robust authentication, authorisation, permission checks, auditability, and human-in-the-loop patterns for agent actions. - You can create reusable agent platforms, developer tooling, quality frameworks, and engineering standards that allow multiple teams to safely ship high-quality AI experiences. - You communicate technical decisions and risks clearly to stakeholders and work effectively with Product, Design, Data, Security, Infrastructure, and domain teams. YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF - You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself. - You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations, they're internal ones. - You're comfortable with ambiguity. Give you a problem, not a prescription, and you'll run with it. - You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you're thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders. - You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it. LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM AI at Airwallex is building the path from financial software to autonomous finance. At the center of this vision is Kai, Airwallex’s AI assistant and the intelligent interface to our global financial platform. Kai connects AI with capabilities across payments, accounts, transfers, cards, expenses, and other financial workflows—enabling customers to describe what they want to achieve while the system handles more of the complexity underneath. You’ll build intelligent financial products and autonomous agents that understand business context, plan and reason across multi-step workflows, execute actions within clearly defined controls, and learn from outcomes. The work spans agent architecture, orchestration, context and knowledge systems, ontology, evaluation, governance, monitoring, and reliability. The challenge is uniquely demanding: AI systems are probabilistic, while moving money requires precision, permissions, auditability, deterministic controls, and regulatory compliance. You’ll help define where AI should reason and where financial infrastructure must remain deterministic—turning frontier models into safe, controllable systems that businesses can trust. Join exceptional engineers advancing Kai from assistance to action and, ultimately, toward autonomous finance—where customers define the outcome they want and intelligent systems securely execute more of the work required to achieve it. Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent.
